sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a scruffy dog standing on all four legs. Draw this exact dog as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the body: the scruffy brown-and-white furry body seen from the side as in image 1, from the chest with the red collar and its gold tag at the front to the rump at the back, without head, without tail and without any legs: no legs, no shoulders, no thighs, no haunches and no paws drawn on it — its underside one smooth rounded line from the chest to the rump; the top of the neck, normally under the head, rounded.
2. the head: the dog's head with its white muzzle, black nose and brown patches, turned to the viewer as in image 1, with a completely blank face — no eyes, no eyebrows, no mouth, no tongue — keep the black nose and the rosy cheeks; without ears; its bottom edge, at the chin and neck, rounded.
3. the left ear: the floppy brown ear on the left of image 1, hanging down, with a rounded base.
4. the right ear: the floppy brown ear on the right of image 1, hanging down, with a rounded base.
5. one front leg: the near front leg of image 1 (under the chest) drawn whole, from the top of the shoulder down to the fluffy white paw, straight as in image 1; its top the full, smooth, rounded curve of the shoulder.
6. one back leg: the near back leg of image 1 drawn whole, from the top of the haunch down to the paw: the big rounded thigh, the bent hock and the fluffy paw; its top the full, smooth, rounded curve of the haunch.
7. the tail: the fluffy brown-and-white tail curled up as in image 1, with a rounded base.
8. a small round red rubber ball.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a scruffy dog; image 2 shows the same dog cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the dog's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the dog in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2.

Draw each piece on its own, spread out in tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. the dog's left eye (on the right of image 1): a dark round eye with a white sparkle, as it is in image 1.
2. the same eye wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, with its white sparkle.
3. the same eye gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line with a few lashes.
4. the same eye closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc.
5. the same eye sad: looking down, its upper lid tilted up towards the middle, a thin shine of a welling tear along its bottom rim.
6. the same eye crying: gently squeezed shut, a soft downward-curving line (a sad closed eye, not a smile), a few small lashes, and one small light-blue teardrop just below its outer end.
7. its eyebrow as it is in image 1: a short soft brown arched tuft.
8. the same eyebrow sad: tilted up at its inner end.
9. the mouth as it is in image 1: a happy open pant with the pink tongue hanging out, without the nose.
10. the mouth closed in a gentle smile: just the curved line, no tongue, without the nose.
11. the mouth wide open in a big happy bark, the inside pink, without the nose.
12. the mouth open in a small round 'o', without the nose.
13. the mouth in a small sad frown, without the nose.
14. the mouth sobbing: a small open downturned frown with a little pink inside, trembling, without the nose.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a scruffy dog; image 2 shows the same dog cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw one single piece, centred on the sheet: the dog's head together with its neck, as one piece. It is exactly the head of image 2 — the same scruffy head with its white muzzle, black nose, brown patches and rosy cheeks, the same completely blank face (no eyes, no eyebrows, no mouth, no tongue), without ears, turned the same way, the same drawing style, colours, texture and line — but there is no chin line under it: the white furry throat and the brown fur at the sides of the neck carry straight on down below the head, as wide as the head, for about half the head's height, the way the head flows into the chest in image 1, with no collar, and end in a smooth rounded bottom edge. At the size the head has in image 1. Nothing else on the sheet. No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows. Fully transparent background.
